profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware. The company describes itself as a system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and delivers localized products through integration into development pipelines. Its platform is designed to help businesses ship translated products across multiple markets from a single environment.

The company's primary AI product, Lokalise AI, is positioned as a localization tool that applies approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary to keep translations consistent across languages. The platform uses Custom AI Profiles and metadata to provide context for translations, and includes an AI Scoring feature that automatically evaluates translation quality, routing only low-confidence results to human reviewers. Lokalise also describes dynamic LLM selection, where the system routes requests to different large language models based on language, content, and context without repeated configuration by the user. The company notes on its site that AI translation tools cannot fully replace human translators but can reduce time and effort significantly.

The held facts show Lokalise has eleven items of Delaware legal exposure and the product is noted as UK-hosted in addition to its Delaware registration. No litigation cases or MCP server entries are recorded for the company at this time.
